trusted_basis.review_boundary: Independent Control Review must accept this exact package before P32 mutation.
trusted_basis.test_cli_rule: Resolve exact CTest targets from discovery; unmatched names are failures, never PASS.

obligations.requirement: Freeze one canonical Document/Session/Scene/Frame owner, narrow ports, lifecycle, failure recovery and composition dependency direction.
obligations.oracle: implementation-design-preflight.json plus source call-chain review against existing SceneBinding, IncrementalRuntimeCoordinator, CanvasEditingRuntime and RuntimeFrameCoordinator.
obligations.acceptance: No unresolved semantic/authority/verification/scope decisions; every R1-R4 obligation maps to an executable oracle.

obligations.requirement: Both incremental Scene query/spatial and full RuntimeScene reference/inspection derivations preserve complete identity, kind/version, transforms, properties, content, erase masks, placement, bounds, dependencies and explicit invalidation domains.
obligations.oracle: Full/Delta/Recovery/Remove/Restore/reparent equivalence fixture with complete ObjectId and long OrderKey collision/tie-break cases, content/style/erase/resource invalidations and failure injection.
obligations.acceptance: Atomic publication exposes either the previous complete snapshot or the new complete snapshot; no truncated identity/order or kind_version-only invalidation.

obligations.requirement: One pull-plus-notify resource port validates a copied binding snapshot derived from the Document ResourceManifest (and existing canonical BrushResourceBinding cross-check) for binding/epoch/version/hash/request lifetime and refreshes image/text/brush derived state at owner safe points without Document Operation/Undo.
obligations.oracle: First resolve the accepted Document ResourceManifest source. If no typed manifest is present at the accepted implementation revision, emit BLOCKED_AUTHORITY and stop before production mutation; otherwise run the pull-plus-notify resource schedule covering missing/bytes-accepted/decode-ready/layout-ready/fail/evict/retry/provider-replace, shared resources, same ObjectId/ResourceId value, wrong hash/version/binding, late completion and resource refresh followed by operation/Undo/Recovery.
obligations.acceptance: The accepted semantic implementation must expose a canonical ResourceManifest binding before R2 implementation. Provider bytes or a composition-owned manifest cannot substitute. Once bound, only Document ResourceManifest/canonical BrushResourceBinding metadata authorizes bytes; missing or mismatched image/font manifest remains unverified/missing; stale/late completions cannot satisfy a new binding; dependent Scene/query/hit/render/readback/frame revisions update atomically while semantic generation and history remain unchanged.

obligations.requirement: Per-instance internal Runtime composition owns create/open, bind, input/control/operation/resource/frame ingress, owner pump, query/readback and staged close through quiescence.
obligations.oracle: Lifecycle matrix plus two-instance interleaving, lost/recover/rebind, close with late completion, callback no-reentry and independent Canonical/Preview role generations.
obligations.acceptance: No half-published instance or borrowed owner pointer after close; instance state and pending receipts are isolated; platform retains threads/locks/GPU affinity and execution feedback.

obligations.requirement: Windows and Web Minimal consumers use the same composition, do not link Playground/Debug UI in core, support debug-on/off Web and real resource/input/surface lifecycle.
obligations.oracle: Target dependency inventory, Windows native build/exe identity, Web debug-on/off build and local service entry, Minimal consumer end-to-end create/select/modify/cancel/Undo/Redo/query/readback plus resource refresh and close/late completion.
obligations.acceptance: Both consumers execute the same semantic intentions and isolation checks; no duplicate Host business logic or HUD-only path; Android remains deferred.

obligations.requirement: Complete ObjectId and OrderKey identities remain collision-safe and stable.
obligations.oracle: Two IDs with equal first bytes, two resource requests with same numeric value but different binding/version, long common-prefix OrderKeys and equal-key stable tie-break.
obligations.acceptance: No collision, deletion, eviction or reorder aliasing.

obligations.requirement: Accepted interaction, Preview/Canonical, control/readback and resource/scene regressions remain active; upstream F01-F08 are re-audited without being silently absorbed.
obligations.oracle: Exact discovered CTest matrix plus upstream dependency audit against the accepted implementation revision.
obligations.acceptance: No protected test is weakened or omitted; unresolved upstream defect returns a classified blocker.

obligations.requirement: Only authorized Scene/resource/composition/Minimal consumer/test/evidence paths change; historical control records and protected packages remain byte-identical.
obligations.oracle: Exact diff from task anchor, protected manifest hash audit and git diff --check.
